description: Eledone — Colore: Raw Umber & silvery gold texture Collezione: Polpo Codice: 7013 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Large Altezza: 55.3 cm Rapporto: 55.3 cm × 44.7 cm Toni: Brown Named after Eledone , a genus of small octopuses native to the Mediterranean , Eledone fuses the fine, cellular texture of octopus skin with the speckled particulate of Venetian terrazzo . Its dotted composition creates a layered, tactile surface in which biology and architecture converge to create a new kind of animal print . The pattern speaks to the depth and complexity of Venice's enduring craftsmanship and its continual dialogue with the sea. I nspired by macro scopic views of octopus skin in combination with Venetian terrazzo floors , Eledone functions as a textured field , lending depth and material presence to interiors.
